What is your favorite internet browser extension?

RequestPolicy for Firefox https://addons.mozilla.org/pt-br/firefox/addon/requestpolicy/

It's an extension that prohibits websites from making any call to servers that are not on their own domain name. This stops ads, third-party Javascript and so on. Your Internet becomes a lot faster, really because now you're only talking to a single server instead of 20 every time you browse a page. Not all sites work like this (Voat does!) but you can easily configure exceptions or disable the add-on temporarily.

I really hope that at some point this is added as a built-in features for browsers, it would force the Internet to up it's game and quit a lot of bullshitting - like having to make 50 different requests to fully load a single page (which should be 1 request).
